records.title: Solat Ketika Sakit — differentiated applied practice
records.src: Official original PI KSSR2017 T6 PDF page 46 (printed 34), SHA fd12636abb8b220623ec8c33a0c12261c7f27adc44c02efc5ee2ac04b71fea45
records.objectives: Practice selected solat ketika sakit modalities; analyze importance of worship during illness, show proper adab
records.teacher: Provide safe fictional situations and model approved method using stable chair and prayer mat
records.students: Use role-play in groups, compare suitable approaches, justify two choices and reflect
records.assessment: Rubric for ordering, adab, explanation and teacher follow-up
records.note: RPT source L060 wrongly describes Solat Berjemaah (T5); official DSKP source T6 SK4.2 is Solat Ketika Sakit. Original L059 already covers SP4.2.3–5. Treat L060 as differentiated application, not new SK.

records.title: Tasmi al-Ma'arij 40–44 / Nuh 1–28 / al-Jinn 1–13 (verified mushaf selection)
records.src: RPT PI T6 L117 — source also includes az-Zumar 1–5 erroneously within Juz29 context
records.objectives: Complete selected tasmi from specified ayat while correcting source juz mixup
records.teacher: Check surah and ayat in mushaf; exclude az-Zumar 1–5 from Juz29 review, supervise tasmi
records.students: Locate ayat in mushaf, read short passage and record actual ayat achieved
records.assessment: Tajwid/fluency checklist with actual surah and ayat
records.note: az-Zumar 1–5 is NOT Juz 29 and cannot be labelled as such; separate until teacher assigns accurate context.
